attributes.board_name: West Virginia Board of Occupational Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: Workshops, seminars, conferences, in-service (1 h per hour; in person, online, live or pre-recorded); academic courses (3 h per credit hour); presentations (2 h per presentation hour, first time only); writing (book max 10, chapter/journal article max 5, newsletter article max 3); research projects (max 6 each); independent learning; fieldwork/clinical instruction (capped per category) and other activities in 13CSR4 §3.8. No pre-approval of courses or providers. Core job requirements (CPR, first aid, documentation, coding/billing training) do not count.
rules.new_licensee_rule: First West Virginia license obtained in the first 12 months of a 24-month reporting period: 12 contact hours before the end of that period.
rules.carryover: Up to 6 excess contact hours may be carried to the next licensure period.
rules.audit_note: Attest on the renewal application. Random CE audit: selected licensees are notified by mail and must upload CE documents; no renewal until the audit is completed.
rules.legal_basis: W. Va. Code R. §13-4 (Continuing Education and Competence), amended eff. July 1, 2026; W. Va. Code §30-28-7
rules.notes: 24 contact hours in the 2 years before renewal. Military active duty 3–12 months in the period: 12 hours; more than 12 months: exempt. Rule amended effective July 1, 2026.
